pack.title: Friends selling mlm
pack.description: Support a friend without joining their sales pitch.

scenarios.setting: A friend repeatedly invites you to a business opportunity meeting.
scenarios.jab: Just come to one meeting; you're not supporting me otherwise.
scenarios.goal: Support a friend without joining their sales pitch.

replies.line: I care about you. I'm not joining the business.
replies.why: It separates the relationship from participation in the venture.
replies.delivery: Pause between caring about your friend and declining the business; make both statements sincere.

replies.line: I'm not joining. Let's meet for coffee.
replies.why: It closes the pitch and offers a social connection instead.
replies.delivery: Pause between caring about your friend and declining the business; make both statements sincere.

replies.line: I hope it goes well for you; I'd rather spend time together outside the business.
replies.why: It expresses goodwill while declining the commercial invitation.
replies.delivery: Pause between caring about your friend and declining the business; make both statements sincere.

replies.line: Coffee, yes. A new career, no.
replies.why: The contrast keeps the refusal light while distinguishing friendship from recruitment.
replies.delivery: Pause between caring about your friend and declining the business; make both statements sincere.

followUp.jab: But this could change your life.
followUp.line: I hear your enthusiasm; my answer about joining is still no.
followUp.why: It recognizes their excitement without reopening the decision.
followUp.delivery: Pause between caring about your friend and declining the business; make both statements sincere.
